about: Packagist.org is the main PHP/Composer package repository. This CLI searches packages, faceted by tags and type, and reads package metadata, install and PHP-version statistics, dependents, suggesters, security advisories, vendor package lists, popular and new packages, PHP extensions and global stats.

commands.summary: Search Packagist packages by keyword, optionally filtered by package type and tags. Uses the official search.json API.

params.name: type
params.description: Package type filter, e.g. library, project, symfony-bundle, composer-plugin, php-ext, wordpress-plugin, magento2-module

commands.summary: Search packages through the site's Algolia index. Returns hits plus facet counts per tag and type. Supports Algolia filter expressions; page is 0-based.

params.name: filters
params.description: Algolia filter expression on facets 'type' and 'tags'. Use %20 for spaces. Examples: 'type:library', 'tags:logging', 'type:library%20AND%20tags:logging'. Empty means no filter.

commands.summary: Search the values of a search facet (tags or type) by prefix, with counts within a keyword query. Useful for finding valid tag names to filter on.

params.name: facet_query
params.description: Prefix of the facet value, e.g. 'sym'

params.name: query
params.description: Package keyword query that restricts which packages are counted

commands.summary: Get full package metadata as JSON: description, maintainers, repository, download totals, favers, and all versions with their requirements.

params.name: vendor
params.description: Vendor name, the part before the slash

params.name: package
params.description: Package name, the part after the slash

commands.summary: Get a time series of daily installs for a package, averaged daily, weekly or monthly, starting from a date.
Get a time series of daily installs for a package, split by major version (1, 2, 3, ...).
Get a time series of installs for a package, split by the PHP version (and HHVM) used by installers.
Get the rendered detail block for one package version by its numeric version id: version number, release date, and requires/suggests/provides/conflicts. Returned as an HTML fragment inside JSON.

params.name: id
params.description: Numeric version id, as used on package pages

commands.summary: List packages that depend on a given package. Can sort by downloads and filter by require or require-dev.
List packages that suggest a given package in their composer.json 'suggest' section.
List known security advisories (PKSA id, CVE, affected versions, severity) for a package via the official API.

params.name: updatedSince
params.description: Only advisories updated after this Unix timestamp

commands.summary: Get one security advisory by its PKSA id: severity, title, CVE/GHSA ids, affected package and versions, and reporting sources.
List all package names published under a vendor, optionally filtered by package type.

params.name: type
params.description: Package type filter, e.g. library, symfony-bundle, composer-plugin

commands.summary: List the most popular packages on Packagist, paginated.
Get the Browse page lists, in this order: New Releases (with version), New Packages, Popular Packages and Random Packages.
List PHP extension packages that can be installed with PIE, paginated.
Get Packagist-wide totals: packages registered, versions available, and total package installs since 2012.
